resultJson.title: Migrate build to sbt 2.x
resultJson.body:
This PR moves the build to sbt `2.1.0-RC3`, as the user asked ("migrate to sbt 2.x").

- **Website settings moved into `project/Website.scala` and applied only to `root`.** sbt 2.x applies bare settings in `.sbt` files to every subproject, so `website.sbt` is removed. The `-siteroot` scaladoc option now comes from `docs / mdocOut` instead of the hard-coded `zio-magnum-docs/target/mdoc` path.
- **Dependency versions moved from an anonymous `new { ... }` object in `build.sbt` to `project/Versions.scala`.**
- **PlantUML output:** in the `docs` project, the PlantUML target directory is added to `Compile / managedResourceDirectories`, because sbt 2.x requires generated resources to be in a managed resource directory.
- **Formatting:** some Scala sources were reformatted with scalafmt. These are whitespace and layout changes only.

The branch also adds `.orca/` files (run progress and stack settings). The comment in `settings.properties` still says `sbt.version=1.13.1`.
